title: Llama.cpp Ships Multimodal Decision Model Support in v0.6.0
summary:
The Clef and Clef-Flash models are now available for local deployment on the latest version of the llama.cpp inference engine. This update, released as v0.6.0, introduces multimodal support for decision models and includes performance enhancements for the Metal API to accelerate on-device execution on Apple hardware. Users can now serve these models using a single llama serve command for visual and text-based analysis.

The engine utilizes a /v1/systemone endpoint for Jev-style inference, which allows agents to route tickets, moderate content, or rank options by providing probabilities without generating text. The project supports various open models ranging from 144M to 27B parameters. Community testing shows the 421M parameter Laya model performs nearly as well as Qwen 4B while operating at 12x the speed.
